about.heading: About
paragraphs: Born in 1977, trained as a master automotive technician. At 21, I took over my family's business - and over the following 25 years built it into a regional mobility and transport company, which I sold in 2023. That period shaped my entrepreneurial thinking more than anything before it.

What has stayed with me is what has always interested me: things with substance. Vehicles, buildings, businesses. Today I work across four fields - a vehicle workshop focused on Mercedes-Benz and sports cars, the restoration and trade of collector cars, the renovation of my own properties in Germany, Austria and Portugal, and a facility management business.
If any of this is of interest - feel free to get in touch.

intro.heading: Automobiles
intro.text: What is a profession in the workshop is a passion here.

items.title: Mercedes-Benz 190 SL, 1962
items.text: Found on a property together with several other disused vehicles, overgrown and unused for years. The body was fully repaired, the engine overhauled, and the soft top and interior newly made. Today it's a gleaming roadster in its original colour.
items.beforeAlt: Two weathered vintage cars in a field before restoration
items.afterAlt: Restored blue Mercedes-Benz roadster after restoration

items.title: Mercedes-Benz W113 Pagoda, 1968
items.text: Taken on as a barn find with a seized engine and patchy history. Engine and transmission were fully rebuilt, chrome trim replated, and the soft top and interior renewed. It's back on the road today in its original specification.
items.beforeAlt: Rusted vintage car in front of a storage building before restoration
items.afterAlt: Restored white Mercedes-Benz Pagoda after restoration

items.title: Mercedes-Benz SL, 1988
items.text: Taken on already stripped down to the bare body, with the paint and underbody badly affected. The body was repaired and painted by hand, the mechanicals fully overhauled, and the interior newly fitted. Today it's a complete, roadworthy car once again.
items.beforeAlt: Bare classic car body on a stand in the workshop before restoration
items.afterAlt: Restored silver Mercedes-Benz SL after restoration

items.title: Porsche 911, 1976
items.text: Came into the workshop after years of daily use, with wear to the suspension and mechanicals. The engine was fully rebuilt, the suspension returned to original specification, and the paint refinished. Today it's a reliable classic with unspoiled character.
items.beforeAlt: Porsche 911 on the lift during restoration

items.caption: Private collection - several classics under one roof

automobile.outro: Now and then I part with a car, or I'm looking for one. If that's of interest, just give me a call.

datenschutz.heading: Privacy Policy
datenschutz.intro: This website deliberately avoids cookies, tracking, analytics tools and contact forms. No personal data is collected beyond the server log files that are technically unavoidable when the site is accessed.

sections.heading: Hosting and Server Log Files
sections.text: When you visit this website, the hosting provider automatically collects technical information transmitted by your browser. This includes: IP address, date and time of the request, page requested, and the browser and operating system used. These server log files are used solely for the technical security and stability of the site and are not combined with other data sources.

sections.heading: No Cookies, No Tracking
sections.text: This website does not use cookies or any analytics or tracking tools. Your usage behaviour is not evaluated in any way.

sections.heading: Fonts
sections.text: The fonts used on this website are hosted locally (self-hosted). No connection is made to Google Fonts or any other external font service.

sections.heading: No Forms
sections.text: This website contains no contact forms. Contact is made exclusively through the channels you choose yourself - phone, WhatsApp, email or LinkedIn.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.text: Since no personal data is collected beyond the technically unavoidable server log files, no further rights to access, correction or deletion typically arise from this. If you have any questions about data protection, you can reach me at any time using the contact details listed in the legal notice.
